Learn AI basics in 30 days, free.

Week 1: use one chatbot daily for study doubts. Learn role, task, format.
Week 2: try NotebookLM on your notes. Fact-check an answer with a second tool.
Weeks 3 and 4: automate one boring task, then build one small project and show it to a friend.
